## Bug Analysis

The error occurs because `ExponentiatedGradient` passes a `sample_weight` parameter directly to the estimator's `fit()` method, but when the estimator is a `Pipeline`, it doesn't accept `sample_weight` as a top-level parameter. Instead, Pipeline requires parameters to be prefixed with the step name (e.g., `logisticregression__sample_weight`).

## Fix

The solution is to modify the `ExponentiatedGradient` initialization to specify the sample weight parameter name using the stepna
